reviews.text: A Chimney King performed repairs on my chimney. These guys are honest, hard working and dependable. They were respectful of my home and did a great job. Solid, professional job extending the life of my chimney for decades to come.
reviews.author: Bob

reviews.text: I contacted A Chimney King for a fireplace and chimney inspection and had an outstanding experience. They are timely, polite, professional and do high quality work at a very fair price.
reviews.author: Review P.

reviews.text: A Chimney King is a great find! They were responsive to our inquiry (other companies never responded), and gave us a fair price to re-line our oil burner chimney. They also repaired and sealed our chimney, plus a much needed new chimney cap.
reviews.author: Laura B.
